findings.claim: Validate the enclosing banner region even when its inner paragraph already has role="status". AC7 and codex-r3-1 remain partially unresolved.
findings.evidence:
By inspection, replace MOCK_P in tests/page-check.test.ts with '

Mock bundle — placeholder data, not results

Radar match passed

'. The outer div has two text-bearing children, so the container walk at lines 156-159 stops at the first p. The live-region search at lines 160-162 also stops at that p, whose text is exact. The outer status region and its added claim are never checked; the unchanged mode, main and footer checks also accept the fixture. The existing second-paragraph regression at tests/page-check.test.ts:190 omits role="status" from the inner p, unlike the actual MockBanner at components/mock-banner.tsx:12. Add this regression and validate the enclosing banner region's complete text.
